sentiment.rationale: Salesforce raised its full-year FY26 revenue guidance to $41.45-$41.55 billion from a prior range of $41.1-$41.3 billion, and raised operating cash flow growth guidance to approximately 13%-14% from 12%-13%. The guidance raise is partially attributed to the Informatica acquisition (approximately 80bps contribution), but the organic cRPO growth of 11% Y/Y and strong bookings momentum, described as 'exceptional' and the 'best quarter in three years,' indicate genuine operational strength. Management expressed high confidence in the forward outlook, citing a 'powerful pipeline of future revenue' and reacceleration of revenue in 12-18 months.

summary.revenue: Q3 FY26 revenue of $10.3 billion, up 9% Y/Y and 8% in constant currency. Subscription & support revenue of $9.7 billion, up 10% Y/Y and 9% in CC.
summary.eps: Q3 FY26 GAAP diluted EPS of $2.19, up from $1.58 in the prior year. Non-GAAP diluted EPS of $3.25, up from $2.41 in the prior year.
summary.guidance: Raised full-year FY26 revenue guidance to $41.45-$41.55 billion (up 9%-10% Y/Y, ~9% CC), including ~80bps Informatica contribution. Maintained non-GAAP operating margin guidance at 34.1%. Raised full-year FY26 operating cash flow growth guidance to ~13%-14% Y/Y. Q4 FY26 revenue guidance of $11.13-$11.23 billion (up 11%-12% Y/Y).
summary.margin: Q3 FY26 GAAP operating margin of 21.3% (up 130bps Y/Y) and non-GAAP operating margin of 35.5% (up 240bps Y/Y). Full-year FY26 GAAP operating margin guidance of 20.3% and non-GAAP operating margin guidance of 34.1%.
key_risks: Faster than anticipated mix shift to cloud for Tableau and on-prem revenue timing in Tableau and MuleSoft, creating less predictable revenue quarter over quarter.
Weakness in marketing and commerce segments.
Asia Pacific growth constrained, particularly in Australia and India.
Comms and media, and manufacturing, automotive, and energy industries were more measured.
Uncertainties regarding AI technologies and their integration into product offerings.
Risks associated with the Informatica acquisition, including integration and retention of key personnel.
key_opportunities: Agentforce and Data 360 ARR reached nearly $1.4 billion, up 114% Y/Y, with Agentforce ARR surpassing half a billion, up 330% Y/Y.
Over 9,500 paid Agentforce deals, up 50% Q/Q, and 3.2 trillion tokens processed.
50% of Agentforce and Data 360 Q3 bookings came from existing customer expansion.
Salesforce capacity increased ~23% Y/Y, with pipeline generation at record levels.
Informatica acquisition completed, expected to be accretive within 12 months and contribute ~80bps to FY26 revenue growth.
New products like Agentforce ITSM and Life Sciences Cloud gaining traction, with Life Sciences Cloud new bookings tripling Y/Y.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Management used highly confident language throughout, describing Q3 cRPO as 'exceptional,' the quarter as the 'best quarter in three years,' and expressing excitement about the future, with Marc Benioff stating 'we are uniquely positioned for this new area.'
